invariants.text: Person may exist without Account. Account belongs to exactly one Person.
Account.email is forbidden; Person.email is the single login identifier.
username is unique case-insensitively, stable, never a credential/login/recovery identifier.
Authority = union of active RoleAssignment scopes; default DENY.
ADMIN does not inherit sports authority. CAPTAIN ≠ COACH. SUBCOMMITTEE ≠ COACH.
Role scope validity: PLAYER→TEAM, CAPTAIN→TEAM, COACH→TEAM|EVENT, SUBCOMMITTEE→CLUB, ADMIN→CLUB.
PLAYER responds only to own Availability.
Published SelectionRevision is immutable; republication creates new revision.
Event terminal states (CANCELLED, COMPLETED, ABANDONED) survive historical participation records.
Archived Competition cannot be selected for new assignment; historical references remain valid.
Team identity = Season + Division + Line, immutable once created.
Attendance correction preserves before/after; MatchRecord correction preserves before/after.
Business history and audit log are distinct; neither replaces the other.
UNRECORRED ≠ ABSENT in AttendanceEntry.
DRAFT is non-observable atomic intermediate for Event creation; persisted as SCHEDULED.
Material change list: startAt, endAt, venueId, targets, clubWideTarget, opponent, competitionId, logistics.
coordinationRevision increments on material change; derives Availability.NEEDS_RECONFIRMATION.
No transition out of COMPLETED or ABANDONED; CANCELLED → SCHEDULED (restore) allowed.
AttendanceSheet: no reopening; correction is the only path after CLOSED.
MatchRecord correction is separate operation, not transition back to DRAFT.
PlayerMatchStats frozen on MatchRecord.state=FINAL.
Announcement audience frozen at PUBLISHED; corrections only title/body; revision increments.
DIRECT: exactly one canonical conversation per unordered person pair.
TEAM: at most one canonical conversation per Team. EVENT: at most one per Event.
Notification dedupeKey logical uniqueness prevents duplicates.
AuditEntry append-only; no update, no delete; sensitive fields redacted.
Venue metadata edit does not reschedule events or increment coordination revision.
Changing venue on Event is a material event change.
Jornada: all matches have Event.seasonId = Jornada.seasonId and Event.type=MATCH.
If Jornada.competitionId set, each match's competitionId is null or equal to it.
Series targeting materialized on each occurrence Event via EventTargetTeam/EventTargetPerson.
maxOccurrences ≤ 366 (TECHNICAL POLICY).
Bulk Jornada scheduling ≤ 100 matches per command (TECHNICAL POLICY).
TeamAssignment atomic with RoleAssignment PLAYER (create/end together).
Person.activeTeamAssignments / activeRoleAssignments evaluated at instant; temporal validity.

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Scope Reconciliation V1.1 line 19 (self-service recovery) vs Product Truth V1.1 / Target UX / Auth Reconciliation (administrative recovery)
reconciliationLog.resolution: Administrative recovery is final; Scope Reconciliation line 19 is a documentation error superseded
reconciliationLog.implementationConsequence: No self-service forgot-password endpoint; recovery = admin re-issue setup code

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Target UX Freeze lists 8 notification types vs canonical 7 types in class model
reconciliationLog.resolution: 7 canonical types final; MESSAGE_RECEIVED and RECORD_FINALIZED not persisted notification types

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Target UX authority derivation lists EligibilityConstraint vs Scope Reconciliation (Eligibility OUT)
reconciliationLog.resolution: EligibilityConstraint removed from authority sources; authority = RoleAssignment + Membership + TeamAssignment only
reconciliationLog.implementationConsequence: Authority service does not read Eligibility tables

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Class Catalog V1.1 (33 classes) vs older Class Attributes (retired entities/fields)
reconciliationLog.resolution: Class Catalog V1.1 overrides; retired fields removed

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: State Model Catalog V1.1 (14 active machines) vs State Transition Matrix (archived machine rows)
reconciliationLog.resolution: Catalog V1.1 overrides; Competition has no state machine

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Target UX Resource Ownership lists CompetitionEntry under SUBCOMMITTEE+ADMIN vs Scope Reconciliation (CompetitionEntry OUT)
reconciliationLog.resolution: CompetitionEntry removed; Competition simple context only

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Scope Reconciliation line 19 (self-service recovery) vs Product Truth / Target UX / Auth Reconciliation
reconciliationLog.resolution: Same as REC-01

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Class Catalog role scope combinations vs any historical LINE scope
reconciliationLog.higherAuthority: Class Catalog V1.1 + Actor Model V1.1
reconciliationLog.resolution: LINE scope does not exist; scope validity = PLAYER→TEAM, CAPTAIN→TEAM, COACH→TEAM|EVENT, SUBCOMMITTEE→CLUB, ADMIN→CLUB

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: AnnouncementRevision mentioned in some sources vs class model (no AnnouncementRevision entity)
reconciliationLog.resolution: AnnouncementRevision not an entity; corrections via revision++ on Announcement

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Notification read acknowledgement via separate table vs Notification.readAt
reconciliationLog.resolution: Read acknowledgement = Notification.readAt of type ANNOUNCEMENT_PUBLISHED

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Message pending/failed send state in UI vs domain-persisted states only
reconciliationLog.resolution: Domain states = SENT/EDITED/DELETED only; pending/failed frontend-only

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Guardian delegation surfaces in some UX gap docs vs Guardian OUT
reconciliationLog.resolution: Guardian delegation removed; no delegated Availability
reconciliationLog.implementationConsequence: No GuardianRelationship table or delegated response command

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Unread-first conversation sorting vs last-activity DESC
reconciliationLog.resolution: last activity DESC; unread = presentation only

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Event DRAFT as externally observable vs non-observable atomic intermediate
reconciliationLog.resolution: DRAFT non-observable; creation atomic as SCHEDULED
reconciliationLog.implementationConsequence: Backend creates Event as SCHEDULED in single command

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Series-level target entities vs targets materialized on occurrences
reconciliationLog.resolution: No EventSeriesTargetTeam/Person; targets on each Event

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Jornada moved to Más in legacy vs Jornada in Calendar/Participation
reconciliationLog.resolution: Jornada stays in Calendar/Participation context
reconciliationLog.implementationConsequence: JornadaMatch belongs to Jornada; season coherence enforced

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: ExternalReference as active entity vs DEFER
reconciliationLog.resolution: ExternalReference DEFER; no entity/field/command/query

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Notification dedupeKey variations across sources
reconciliationLog.resolution: dedupeKey = originEventId|resourceType|resourceId|recipientPersonId|type (EVENT_*) or resourceId|recipient|type (others)

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: Competition lifecycle state machine vs archive-as-flag
reconciliationLog.resolution: Competition: ACTIVE ↔ ARCHIVED flag only; no state machine
reconciliationLog.implementationConsequence: No Competition state transitions; archive flag only

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: AttendanceEntry previousValue as derived vs persisted correction field
reconciliationLog.resolution: previousValue persisted on correction
reconciliationLog.implementationConsequence: previousValue column exists; derived state computed

reconciliationLog.sourcesInConflict: RoleAssignment temporalExclusions mutability vs immutability
reconciliationLog.resolution: temporalExclusions MUTABLE; other fields IMMUTABLE
reconciliationLog.implementationConsequence: Only temporalExclusions can be updated after creation
